text:
auditor_sam: Hi all — need SOC2 sample bundle: show RBAC change approvals + KMS usage (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt) for 2024-12-03 01:15-02:15 UTC. Also want chain-of-custody and reproducible export steps. What will you provide?

elaine: I'll own collection. Plan: cloudtrail KMS events, STS/AssumeRole traces, ticket approval PDF, SSO login audit, and runbook excerpt. We'll produce a reproducible script and savedsearch metadata.

praveen: evidence-bot created ticket AUD-7192 and attached initial checklist.

evidence-bot: Ticket AUD-7192 created, assignee: elaine, priority: medium.

mika-security: small ask — include the key policy diff (before/after) if RBAC change touched grants. auditors want to see why a grant was created/removed.

elaine: got it. We'll include `kms_policy_diff.txt` (generated from `git diff` of infra repo commit hashes). Commit: 3f7a9b2.

praveen: Splunk savedsearch name: "audit_kms_rbac_export_2024_12_03". query I plan to run:
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey OR ReEncrypt OR CreateGrant OR RevokeGrant) earliest=1701566100 latest=1701569700 | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, eventID, requestParameters.grantId
```

praveen: STS correlation: `index=auth_logs event=AssumeRole | table _time, user, requestParameters.roleArn, eventID` then join on `eventID`/`sessionName`.

okta-bot: Note: will export okta_audit lines for login+approval events for the timeframe. Will redact e-mail addresses but include `eventId` and `actor.id`.

elaine: packaging approach (auditor preference: split archive): 1) generate ndjson exports; 2) create two tar parts (<2GB each) using `tar --tape-length` for easier transfer; 3) compute sha256 for each part and a manifest; 4) sign the manifest with our GPG key. Commands: `tar -czf part1.tgz --files-from=... --tape-length=2048000` (we'll include exact file lists in `file_list.txt`).

mika-security: for chain-of-custody we'll include: exact CLI commands, Splunk job JSON, savedsearch XML, upload metadata (S3 put event, x-amz-meta-uploader, x-amz-server-side-encryption), and the S3 multipart upload ID if used.

auditor_sam: can you prove keys were ephemeral per policy?

elaine: we'll include KMS admin events (CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, RotateKey) and `aws kms list-grants --key-id` snapshots. Also include `describe-key` output for key state and origin.

praveen: redaction plan: redact external IPs and user emails. We'll provide `redaction_map.csv` with salted hashes mapping to redacted tokens. We'll avoid including raw tokens or PII.

elaine: manifest will include: parts list, sha256s, gpg signature, Splunk job IDs (job: 992233441), savedsearch definition, infra git commit for policy diff, and uploader identity (elaine). We'll upload to `s3://redwood-audit/aud-7192/` with SSE-KMS and provide a presign via secure channel.

auditor_sam: how will you ensure integrity after upload?

praveen: after PUT we'll capture the S3 `PutObject` CloudTrail event and include `x-amz-version-id` + encryption headers, then place that event json in the bundle as `s3_put_event.json`.

mika-security: vuln triage: if any KMS activity correlates to a known CVE window, we'll add `vuln_context.md`. No hits expected but we'll check.

auditor_sam: include evidence that approver identity is real — okta event id or assertion id is fine (not full token).

elaine: will include okta `eventId` and a hashed principal id in `approver_map.csv`. Also add screenshot of approval UI (png) with timestamp metadata.

praveen: ETA: exports started. ETA 60 minutes for bundle. savedsearch job id: 992233441. We'll attach `savedsearch_export.json`.

evidence-bot: Reminder: AUD-7192 handoff call at 2024-12-03T10:30Z — link in ticket.

elaine: upload complete. presign shared off-channel. manifest sha256: a7d4c9b3e2f1c5d6b8a9c0e1f2d3b4c5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1

auditor_sam: checksum verified. I'll validate controls mapping and might request the full policy git history if needed. Thanks team.

mika-security: retention note: artifacts will be retained for 1 year under legal hold then archived per policy. Closing thread unless auditor asks for more.
